display_name: 同记录三视图误差的源频段分解
description: 四个固定绝对频率段测量匹配源 IQ 的 DURA 单视图、三视图均值及误差交叉项。

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 32768 source fit IDs x three aligned simulated source received/DURA/clean IQ views

permissions.claim_scope: Source spectral contributions and nondeployable three-view reference, not identity accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA context cache; no model updates
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed DURA source-only context, 32768 distinct source IDs, three matching clean IQ views, no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen DURA source context, no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: All fixed source records; no checkpoint selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: four fixed frequency bands and five source noise groups

dimensions: all and four source noise quartiles

rows.method: Source-view error and cross-error decomposition by fixed absolute frequency
rows.purpose: Inspect which source frequency ranges benefit from a nondeployable three-view teacher
rows.seed_notes: Fixed original source fit IDs and three existing views; no new randomness or model training
rows.scenario: 64 fixed source training IDs, three source simulation views
expected_artifacts: result.json: four fixed frequency bands and five source noise groups

notes: Frequency ranges fixed before execution, normalized by total clean signal energy; error bands are contributions, not per-band NMSE.
All three source views match physical ID and identical clean; no statistical independence assumption.
Averaging views is source-only and not a deployable inference method; no F/TX/V/target, IQ error is not identity performance.
